name: Jinbo Torajirou
source:
"The Charismatic Pervert."

Torajirou, the student council president, is not just a classmate but also a close confidant of Raito. He possesses a trio of attributes that make him stand out—striking good looks, a sharp intellect, and athletic prowess.

At a glance, Torajirou presents himself as the quintessential diligent student. But beneath this polished exterior lies a naughty side. He frequently succumbs to lecherous glances at girls and often can't resist making inappropriate comments. Yet, he's adept at keeping this side of him under wraps, revealing his true colors only in Raito's presence.

"Why don't you take my hand, Raito? Life’s never boring with me."

Likes: Ladies of all ages, admirers
Dislikes: Men, haters

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/subcharacter.html]official website[/url]]

Drawing parallels to a previous character, Torajirou shares many similarities in appearance and disposition with Midoriba Itsuki. However, a notable divergence exists. While Itsuki was open about his flirtatious tendencies, Torajirou masks his, leading many to perceive him as just another regular, if not excellent, student.
